_comment: Sample data for the judge demo. Loaded through POST /index/listing by scripts/seed_opensearch.py, never written to OpenSearch directly. Shared with Dipanshu's DynamoDB seed script (same source listings, two separate loaders) per BRAIN.md Section E.

listing.description_en: A hand-shaped and hand-painted blue pottery showpiece, fired in a traditional kiln by an artisan family. Makes a striking centerpiece for a shelf or table.
photo_guidance: show size next to a coin
listing.story: Made by a third-generation potter family who learned the craft from their grandparents.

listing.listing_title: Channapatna Lacquered Wooden Spinning Top Set
listing.description_en: A set of five hand-lacquered wooden spinning tops in bright natural dyes, made using the traditional Channapatna toy-turning technique. Safe, non-toxic finish for children.
photo_guidance: lay all pieces out on plain cloth
one close-up of the lacquer sheen
listing.story: Carved and lacquered by a family workshop in Channapatna, India's traditional toy town.

listing.description_en: A small brass figurine cast using the 4,000-year-old Dhokra lost-wax technique, showing a musician playing a traditional drum. Each piece is one-of-a-kind since the mould breaks during casting.
photo_guidance: shoot against a plain dark background to show the brass detail
listing.story: Cast by a tribal artisan cooperative that keeps the Dhokra technique alive.

listing.description_en: A lightweight cotton dupatta hand tie-dyed in the traditional Bandhani technique, in a red and yellow dot pattern. Each dot is tied and dyed by hand, a process taking several days.
photo_guidance: one shot showing the dot pattern up close
listing.story: Tied and dyed by a women's self-help group that has practiced Bandhani for generations.

listing.description_en: A soft, warm pashmina shawl handwoven on a traditional pit loom from fine goat-wool yarn, in a plain natural cream shade with a hand-embroidered border.
photo_guidance: drape over a chair to show the full length and drape
listing.story: Woven by a family of weavers who have worked pashmina looms for over thirty years.

listing.description_en: Thin, crisp moong-dal papad, hand-rolled and sun-dried the traditional way with no preservatives. Roast or fry lightly before serving.
photo_guidance: shoot the stack of papad on a plain plate in daylight
listing.story: Rolled and dried by hand each summer by women in the village, a seasonal household tradition.

listing.listing_title: Homestyle Raw Mango Pickle in Mustard Oil
listing.description_en: Tangy, spicy raw mango pickle made in small batches with mustard oil and a traditional spice blend, matured in sunlight in the classic village style.
photo_guidance: shoot the jar with the lid open to show the pickle texture
listing.story: Made using a recipe passed down through three generations of the seller's family.

listing.listing_title: Hand-Painted Madhubani Fish Motif Wall Art
listing.description_en: A hand-painted Madhubani artwork on handmade paper, showing a traditional fish motif in natural pigments, symbolising fertility and good fortune. Ready to frame.
photo_guidance: shoot flat under even light, no glare
listing.story: Painted by a woman artist trained in the Madhubani style since childhood.

listing.listing_title: Handstitched Cotton Rag Doll in Rajasthani Dress
listing.description_en: A soft, handstitched cotton rag doll dressed in a miniature traditional Rajasthani ghagra-choli with mirror-work embroidery. Filled with natural cotton wadding.
photo_guidance: shoot standing upright against a plain background
listing.story: Stitched by a women's craft collective as an income project alongside farming work.

listing.description_en: A lightweight cotton saree hand block-printed with a floral indigo motif using hand-carved wooden blocks and natural dye, finished with a plain woven border.
photo_guidance: hang the full saree to show the repeat pattern
one close-up of the block print detail
listing.story: Printed by a family workshop using wooden blocks carved by the same family for over forty years.
